_comment: License of each bundled Arduino library. A library's own LICENSE/COPYING file is always included; 'notice' adds the license statement from a source file or README when there's no license file; 'texts' adds shared license texts from this folder.

CapacitiveSensor.note: Release 0.5.1 only says "All rights reserved". The original author later confirmed the MIT license, which was added upstream in commit 2faac42 (github.com/PaulStoffregen/CapacitiveSensor, issue #9); that notice is shown here.
